Marty Morell has played drums and percussion in every conceivable music setting. After classical studies at Julliard, he found success in the jazz world performing and recording with the Al Cohn-Zoot Sims Quintet, Steve Kuhn, Gary McFarland, and Bill Evans. Marty toured with the Duke Ellington Orchestra, performed for Broadway musicals, and is currently on the faculty of the University of Central Florida Music Department.
Marty was interviewed in Orlando, Florida on February 24, 2017 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Orlando, Florida, and I’m very privileged to have Marty Morell with me today. And I’m going to introduce you as a man who wears lots of hats, including the cap you have on today.
Yeah. And drummer/percussionist/vibist band leader, teacher.
Yeah, yeah. Professor. At the University of Central Florida.
